title: musteryblock
description: The mod adds mystical items and blocks with their own mechanics!
body: This mod adds a mystical block and armor with tools! A pickaxe, sword, axe, and full armor set have been added! All of this is better than Netherite armor! You can find the recipes using the JEI mod, which is compatible with this mod! If you click on the mystical block, any mob or item will spawn! The mod is mainly created for fun or for exploring the game! Here's the video: [video](https://youtu.be/G3VhevaWHUc)
